title: Shedeur Sanders cashes in: Browns QB's NFLPA licensing haul tops Tom Brady's record

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders cashes in: Browns QB's NFLPA licensing haul tops Tom Brady's record
sources.description: Sanders earned a record $17.7 million in NFLPA group licensing income during his rookie season, a staggering total fueled by jersey sales, trading cards and one of football's most loyal fanbases
